# Feature: Read-only Discovery

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-08-13 — issue #12 -->

## Intent
Auto-detection without evidence is magic. Discovery scans markers/manifests and returns candidates (Web/Vite/React/Three.js) with evidence and confidence, and writes **no** project file before confirmation (FR-002, BR-001). An empty/unknown repo must not invent a stack (EDGE-001).

## Preconditions
- `packages/cli` exists (#11)
- `packages/schemas` exists (#4)

## Happy Path
- [x] Discovery changes no files (test: `git status` or mtime before/after)
- [x] Supported fixture yields candidates with ≥1 evidence entry and confidence in 0..1
- [x] Empty/unknown directory does not claim a concrete framework stack
- [x] Touched files: zero type escape hatches (typed-strict / Boy Scout)

## Edge Cases
- [x] Unknown repo → generic/unsupported, no invented detection
- [x] Two targets → both candidates, no ambiguous single answer

## Regression
- [x] Existing packages and `pnpm checks` stay green
- [x] Scope: `packages/core/**`, `packages/cli/**`, `fixtures/web-threejs/**`

## Assumptions
- Confidence is derived from marker count, clamped to [0, 1]
- Read-only is enforced by an injected filesystem contract
- Vite+React+Three.js fixture is minimal and deterministic

## Security Coverage
- B-04 N/A; path allowlist under canonical root
- No execution of detected npm scripts
- P-02: errors do not leak internal paths as secrets

## Screenshots
Not applicable.

## Implementation Notes
- `packages/core/src/discovery/` holds the read-only detection aggregate (`detectProject`) and the injected `DiscoveryFs` contract.
- `webDetectors` is exported from core; CLI composes via `packages/cli/src/web-detectors.ts`.
- `potato-boost detect [path]` prints JSON with candidates, evidence, and confidence.
- Fixture `fixtures/web-threejs` is minimal Vite+React+Three.js.
- All 44 tests pass; `pnpm checks` is green.
